messages:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — GPU queue backlog > 10k in us-west-2. HPA reports failing to scale (metrics adapter timeouts). Customers: multiple hosted tenants seeing queued requests and 503s. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcdef | Pager sent to @sre-oncall :rotating_light:

sara: ack — I'm oncall. paging infra/runtime. initial triage: queue size spiked ~22:34 UTC, avg pod GPU util ~98%, HPA events show 'failed to get metrics' errors. Impact: increased latencies and some 503s for generation endpoints. Will post updates here.

mike: seeing repeated 504s from prometheus-adapter to prometheus. adapter containers in kube-system are OOM/restarting. relevant logs: ```
2026-03-14T22:35:12Z prometheus-adapter ERROR: request timeout to /api/v1/query_range
2026-03-14T22:35:13Z prometheus-adapter WARN: scrape backlog=9500 samples, query latency 12s
2026-03-14T22:35:14Z prometheus-adapter FATAL: runtime: out of memory
```

anita: runtime note — workload is hitting gpu-pool-deployment. HPA is configured to use custom metrics (prometheus adapter) for queue_length metric. If adapter doesn't return metrics, HPA can't scale. Short-term: we can manually scale the gpu-pool to absorb backlog. Also consider falling back to CPU-based HPA while we restore adapter.

sara: doing manual scale now. running: ```kubectl -n infra scale deployment/gpu-pool-deployment --replicas=12``` I'll also set a temp annotation to disable HPA to avoid flip-flopping: ```kubectl annotate deployment/gpu-pool-deployment autoscaling.kubernetes.io/skip-metrics=true --overwrite```

sara: scaled -> pods are scheduling but some pending due to node group max size.

mike: increasing node group max size for us-west-2-gpu-asg (current max 10 -> 20). running cloudctl autoscaling update. should allow new nodes to provision quicker.

mike: restarting prometheus-adapter and metrics-server to clear OOM loop: ```kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/prometheus-adapter && kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/metrics-server```

kevin: support impact — alerted top 5 affected customers (Acorp, BrightSales, CampusAI). Acorp seeing ~30% request failures; others high latency. I posted interim note to status.redwood.example: "Degraded performance for model generation in us-west-2; mitigation in progress."

anita: while adapter restarts, switch HPA to fallback: apply config to HPA to use resource CPU metric (quick patch): ```kubectl patch hpa gpu-pool-hpa -p '{"spec":{"metrics":[{"type":"Resource","resource":{"name":"cpu","target":{"type":"Utilization","averageUtilization":70}}}]}}'``` This will let cluster scale based on CPU until custom metrics restored.

sara: CPU-fallback patch applied. HPA started new scale events. queue length dropping from 11,200 -> 3,400 in 6m.

mike: prometheus-adapter pods up and healthy. logs show query latencies back to normal. adapter config had been overloaded by a bad scrape selector (we hit a high-cardinality series explosion). I'm collecting the offending rules.

kevin: support update — Acorp reporting reduced errors, still elevated latency for large generation jobs. Keeping them on priority watch.

anita: follow-up quick fix: reduce Prometheus retention for high-card metrics and add drop_labels rule for ephemeral ids. Also add rate limiting on our adapter queries and increase adapter memory. Long-term: instrument HPA to have an operator fallback if custom metrics fail.

sara: queue is now < 200 and 95th latency returned to baseline ~350ms. autoscaler resumed normal behavior with adapter metrics. Marking incident as mitigated at 23:02 UTC.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> P1 -> moved to postmortem stage. See runbook: https://playbooks.redwood.example/infra/metrics-adapter-failure

keisha-cs: posted status update to customers and updated the status page with timeline + we offered impacted customers a follow-up call.

kevin: handing off to night oncall (kevin) for post-incident monitoring. I'll own the customer comms follow-up and the postmortem write-up. action items created: INFRA-1234 (increase adapter memory + query limits), INFRA-1235 (add HPA operator fallback), INFRA-1236 (prometheus rule cleanup).

anita: adding note to onboarding: validate prometheus high-card rules and add chaos test for adapter latency.

sara: final — saved links to logs/dashboards in the incident ticket. Good job team. :thumbsup:
